description: 宮崎市の津波避難ビル一覧 [tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎市. 宮崎市の津波避難ビル一覧です。 津波避難ビルとは、津波から逃れるために、近隣の方々が緊急・一時的に避難する施設（ビル、マンション、立体駐車場など）で、耐震及び耐波性、津波災害時の想定浸水深に対応できる階高が確保された施設について、施設管理者の同意をいただいて市が指定するものです。 指定避難所については、指定避難所一... Coverage: 宮崎市. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎市. Its tags are 位置情報, 津波避難ビル, 災害, 緯度経度, 避難ビル. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
